source_preparation.event_interpretation: Each native visit represents one original station/collection-time event. Its completed timestamp is the original sample collection timestamp, and its original sample activities retain their individual source rows.
source_preparation.time_interpretation: The original recorded timezone is EST. Native timestamps retain fixed UTC-05:00; source date, clock and timezone strings remain intact in every original activity record.
source_preparation.coordinate_interpretation: Original station coordinates retain NAD83 in their source record and coordinate_reference_system.
